name: ReliefWeb Libya updates
reuseNotes: Verified public RSS on 2026-09-10: https://reliefweb.int/updates/rss.xml?advanced-search=%28PC140%29 (channel title: ReliefWeb - Libya Updates). robots.txt does not disallow /updates/. Collect title, link, pubDate and a short excerpt only. Copyright on the feed: respect original-source IP; do not republish full reports. Node's undici fetch received HTTP 406 ('Blocked due to bot activity') on 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-14 with the identifying collector User-Agent. Node's native https client and curl returned HTTP 200 with the same UA. Collectors therefore use node:http/https, never a browser User-Agent. Fail closed on robots unread or HTTP errors.
